args.sql:
SELECT 
    t1.clientref AS customer_identifier,
    t2.annlincome AS annual_income,
    t2.mthincome AS monthly_income,
    t3.mthexp AS monthly_expenses,
    t3.savamount AS total_savings,
    t3.investamt AS total_investments,
    t3.liqassets AS liquid_assets,
    t3.totassets AS total_assets,
    t3.totliabs AS total_liabilities,
    t3.networth AS net_worth,
    t3.vehvalue AS vehicle_value,
    t3.bankaccbal AS total_bank_account_balances,
    t4.banktxamt AS monthly_transaction_amount,
    t4.lifeinsval AS total_life_insurance_value,
    t5.credscore AS credit_score,
    t5.delinqcount AS delinquency_count,
    t5.latepaycount AS late_payment_count,
    t6.newaccage AS newest_account_age,
    t6.avgaccage AS average_account_age,
    t6.accmixscore AS account_mix_score,
    t6.credlimusage AS credit_limit_usage,
    t6.payconsist AS payment_consistency,
    t6.cardcount AS credit_card_count,
    t6.totcredlimit AS total_credit_limit,
    t6.credutil AS credit_utilization,
    t6.loancount AS loan_account_count,
    t6.activeloan AS active_loan_count,
    t6.totloanamt AS total_loan_amount,
    t6.custservint AS customer_service_interactions,
    t6.produsescore AS financial_product_usage,
    t6.chanusescore AS channel_usage_diversity,
    t6.custlifeval AS customer_lifetime_value
FROM 
    core_record AS t1
JOIN 
    employment_and_income AS t2 ON t1.coreregistry = t2.emplcoreref
JOIN 
    expenses_and_assets AS t3 ON t2.emplcoreref = t3.expemplref
JOIN 
    bank_and_transactions AS t4 ON t3.expemplref = t4.bankexpref
JOIN 
    credit_and_compliance AS t5 ON t4.bankexpref = t5.compbankref
JOIN 
    credit_accounts_and_history AS t6 ON t5.compbankref = t6.histcompref
LIMIT 10;
